name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-rheplicant-e2e-anchor
description: Install anchor for the rheplicant web e2e scenarios. NOT a product: healProfilesModuleFallback walks this manifest's dependencies to decide which packages a composed row can resolve, so declaring them here is what keeps them out of DSH's own bundle and CLI. Every entry must be a `dependencies` entry — the BFS walks dependencies and peerDependencies only, never devDependencies.
